archivedFrenchObjective: Say what you have, what is there, what you need and what you want

archivedRegionalNotesEnglish: Chantier is the standard word for a jobsite in France and Quebec. Quebec crews may also say la job informally.
Casque, gants, bâche and balai are widely understood. Specialized equipment names vary by crew, so confirm them on site.
Vous is the safe default with a crew lead or someone you do not know. Tu is for close, informal contact.

speakingEvidence.archivedFrenchOpening: Chef, j'ai le casque et les gants. J'ai besoin d'un outil. Il n'y a pas de clous sur le toit.
